TEC Lab for the Fall

There are two primary initiatives running through the TEC labs this fall.

  1. Proposal Inverter (August 6th - September 24th)
  2. Rewards Research (October 1st - November 12th)

And two special topics.

  1. Market Models and Networks (September 10th)
  2. NFT Economics (September 17th)

Then two buffer spots towards the end of November, and then a semester review (November 26th), and then break for the winter solstice celebration.

This proposal is requesting $8KWXDAI for the administration of the labs, and to cover the two special topic labs, NFT economics, and Market Network Models. The two primary research initiatives will have additional proposals for funding along with ecosystem partners like primeDAO and sourceCRED.
